patch_list: Removes the ads from the feeds and stops the ad networks from loading.
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops Vizbee, which scans your home network for TVs.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Removes the Storyteller stories and video clips from the feeds.
